paper_title: Axion-like Relics: New Constraints from Old Comagnetometer Data
coupling_convention: g_aNN in GeV^-1 (axion-neutron coupling, inverse-energy dimension) exactly as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper (Bloch, Hochberg, Kuflik, Volansky 2019/2020) recasts old 3He-K comagnetometer data to constrain relic ALP couplings to neutrons (gaNN, Fig.3) and electrons (gaee, Fig.4), both quoted in GeV^-1 (derivative coupling). Primary/strongest result is on neutrons over ma ~ 1e-22 to 4e-13 eV; a separate weaker electron bound also exists. Numerical exclusion values are only shown in figures (unreadable here); the emitted points are an order-of-magnitude estimate from the stated constant-field bound |b_n|<5.5e-33 GeV at 95% CL with rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3 and v~0.77e-3, giving gaNN~3e-9 GeV^-1 (naive; a stochastic correction of O(20) applies and true bound varies with mass). To convert to dimensionless g_an, multiply by ~2 m_N (~1.88 GeV).
